## Programme overview

The Japan QCA Conference will take place on **30–31 October 2026** at **Komatsu Hall, Building 121, B1F, Waseda University, Tokyo**. All times below are in **Japan Standard Time (JST, UTC+9)**.

[View the programme (PDF)](files/JQCA2026_Programme_v2.pdf){.btn .btn-primary} [Download the PDF](files/JQCA2026_Programme_v2.pdf){.btn .btn-outline-primary download="JQCA2026_Programme_v2.pdf"}

The PDF includes the programme in **English and Japanese**, with presentation titles, speakers, discussants, and session assignments.

## Participation and registration

**Advance registration is required.** Please register using the conference participation form and indicate whether you will attend the dinner reception on 30 October.

[Register for the conference via Google Forms ↗](https://forms.gle/fuEkCVLVrqkyKCSr8){.btn .btn-primary target="_blank" rel="noopener" aria-label="Register for the conference using Google Forms in a new tab"}

Keynote speeches and Paper Development Workshops are **in person**. Roundtables and Expert Workshops are **hybrid**, combining in-person and online participation.

## Day 1 — 30 October 2026

Day 1 takes place at Komatsu Hall. The reception is held at B113, B114, B115 and the Lobby.

| Time (JST) | Session |
|:---|:---|
| 10:00–10:05 | Welcome Address — Yuko Kasuya (IPSA President, Waseda University) |
| 10:05–10:30 | Why Japan QCA Conference?: Brief Introduction to QCA — Airo Hino (Waseda University) |
| 10:30–12:00 | Keynote Speech — [Peer Fiss](https://www.peerfiss.com/) (University of Southern California) |
| 12:00–13:00 | Lunch (available on site) |
| 13:00–14:30 | Paper Development Workshop I — Session I+II |
| 14:30–14:45 | Coffee break |
| 14:45–15:45 | Roundtable: QCA as an Approach **(hybrid)** — Moderator & Facilitator: Yuko Kasuya; Panelists: Peer Fiss, Carsten Schneider, and Srikrishna Ayyangar (online) |
| 15:45–16:00 | Coffee break |
| 16:00–18:00 | Expert Workshop I **(hybrid)** — Moderator: Taisuke Fujita (Saitama University) |
| 18:00 | Reception (B113, B114, B115 and Lobby) |

## Day 2 — 31 October 2026

Day 2 takes place at Komatsu Hall, except Paper Development Workshop II, which is held in rooms B113, B114 and B115.

| Time (JST) | Session |
|:---|:---|
| 10:25–10:30 | Day 2 Opening Remarks — Sho Niikawa (Kobe University) |
| 10:30–12:00 | Keynote Speech — [Carsten Schneider](https://people.ceu.edu/carsten-q_schneider) (Central European University) |
| 12:00–13:00 | Lunch at Ohkuma Garden, with an optional campus tour |
| 13:00–14:30 | Paper Development Workshop II — Session III (B115); Session IV (B114); Session V (B113, held in Japanese) |
| 14:30–14:45 | Coffee break |
| 14:45–15:45 | Roundtable: QCA as a Technique **(hybrid)** — Moderator & Facilitator: Airo Hino; Panelists: Carsten Schneider, Peer Fiss, and Sho Niikawa |
| 15:45–16:00 | Coffee break |
| 16:00–17:30 | Expert Workshop II **(hybrid)** — Moderator: Atsushi Ishida (Kwansei Gakuin University) |
| 17:30–18:00 | Conference Summary and Closing Remarks — Narimasa Yokoyama (Doshisha University) and Nobukazu Azuma (Aoyama Gakuin University) |

See the [programme PDF](files/JQCA2026_Programme_v2.pdf) for individual presentations and discussants, and [Venue & Access](venue.qmd) for directions.

## Tips for attending

- **Wi-Fi:** eduroam is available.
- **Luggage:** you can leave luggage at the conference helpdesk.
- **Photos:** photos are taken during the conference. If you have concerns, please let us know.
- **Food and drink:** not allowed in Komatsu Hall, but allowed in the lobby and in rooms B113 to B115.
